posts.cooked: Usual effing Dawn.  I read the game intro and spotted Guise's warning about the Aurora (Thanks, G!), so made my initial card choices with that in mind. The game was rough going for a while, but then things settled down.  I had flipped Dawn and was about to get her to flip back with mostly harmless Citizens in play and D at about 1/3 of her HP, but then a combo of a 2nd Aurora and two Return from the Graves wiped out my plans and had Citizens mowing down my heroes.  Ah well, I'll try again later for Near Mint.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
A few suggestion I'm going to put in white text incase you want to avoid spoilers

Play Gimmicky Character on the turn after Dawn plays Citizen Autumn to avoid Devastating Aurora.   I would also ignore dealing damage to Dawn the first round since she is going to play Healing Light.   Leave Citizen Battery alone.   I'd also suggest using Adhesive Foam Grenade the first round

Mint! The only non-Dawn Citizen I actively targeted was Citizen Tears.  Otherwise, Do All The Damage Right Now to Dawn (and ignoring everyone else) works well.

I normally love Subzero Atmosphere vs Dawn, but couldn't with Autumn out (and me not targetting her) and with AZ always lowest HP (because he was doing all the damage with Thermodynamics and FrostBound Drain.).

Finished after Citizen Blood came out I think (did not see Return with Dawn or 2nd Devastating Aurora).
